home.title: Where are you waiting?
home.noResults: No bus matches that search. Try a route number or a stop name.

live.title: Bus {no} to {dest}
live.delayedBanner: Delayed by traffic. About {n} min behind schedule.
live.breakdownBanner: This bus has broken down. Last seen at {stop}.
live.signalGap: No position for 90 s. The bus may be in a signal gap, so we show a range.
live.noAltTitle: No other bus is running on this route
live.noAltBody: Consider another way to travel. We will tell you if one starts.
live.sheetHandle: Drag to see more or less
live.emergencyBanner: This trip has been suspended after an emergency. Please use another bus.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.footer: Alerts you missed are kept here, so you never return to an empty screen.
alerts.empty: No alerts yet. If your bus is delayed or has a problem, you will see it here.
alerts.delayed: Bus {bus} has been delayed due to a technical issue.
alerts.approaching: Your bus is approximately {n} minutes away.
alerts.nearby: Your bus is approaching your stop.
alerts.breakdown: Bus {bus} has broken down. Next bus approximately {n} minutes away.
alerts.resumed: Bus {bus} has resumed service. Estimated arrival {n} minutes.
alerts.nextBus: The next bus on your route is approximately {n} minutes away.
alerts.breakdownNone: Bus {bus} has broken down. No other bus is running on this route right now.

settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceHelp: Turning this on speaks a short test so you know it works. If your phone has no voice for your language, alerts show as text only. Every spoken message also shows as text.
settings.voiceMissing: This phone has no voice for this language, so alerts will show as text only.
settings.emergencyValue: Add a name and phone number
settings.emergencyHelp: Shared with administrators if you raise an SOS.
settings.deliveryValue: Live while the app is open. Email if you have closed it.

sos.title: Emergency SOS
sos.note: This alerts the transport operator's administrators only. It does not contact police, ambulance or fire services. In an emergency, call 112.
sos.idleCaption: Press and hold for 3 seconds. This prevents accidental alerts.
sos.confirmBody: They will see your name, location and the bus you are on. Your emergency contact is shared if you added one.
sos.sentBody: Administrators have your location and trip details. Stay where you are if it is safe.

driver.notYourBus: Not your bus? Ask the administrator.
driver.readyBody: Starting the trip turns on location sharing. Your phone sends the bus position every few seconds. Keep this screen on while driving.
driver.pausedNote: Passengers have been told. Administrator alerted.
driver.reasonHelp: A fixed list means nothing to type while you are stopped. Passengers see it in their language.
driver.completeNote: Location sharing has stopped. This trip helps make tomorrow's arrival times more accurate.
driver.sosCaption: Trip status becomes Emergency. Routine arrival alerts stop for this trip.

admin.issueDetailHalt: {reason}. Passengers on route {route} have been told and shown the next bus.
admin.issueDetailSlow: {reason}. Passengers on route {route} have been told.

detail.actionHint: For example: called the driver, sent a support vehicle
detail.note: Your response is recorded. This SOS does not contact police, ambulance or fire services. Call 112 if the driver needs them.
detail.notFound: That incident was not found. The demo may have been restarted.

buses.title: Buses
buses.seatsNote: Seating capacity is optional. No feature in this version depends on it.

routes.title: Route {code}
routes.help: Use 150 m among tall buildings or on a wide road, and 60 m only where two stops are very close. A stop that misbehaves can be fixed here without a developer.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.sample: Sample figures. A live system computes these from completed trips.
analytics.delayByRouteSub: Route 12 is the longest, so start there.
analytics.delayByHourSub: The evening peak is the problem, not the route.
